sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: The player states what their character says, does, notices, asks, or feels.
When: Use whenever a scene needs a choice, reaction, question, or character moment before dice.
Not When: Do not force performance; a plain third-person description is enough.
Question: Do I have to act it out?
Answer: No. You can speak in character, summarize in third person, or ask for help finding the words.
Example: A player can say, 'Barnacle hangs back and watches the contact's hands.'
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
